Which creatives spend the most, what they earn, and which show fatigue: a click-through rate that
falls as frequency rises. HOOK is the share of impressions that watched a video's first seconds. The
period is the last 30 complete days unless --last or --from says otherwise.

Usage:
  voidhash ads report creatives [flags]

Flags:
      --currency <code>    ISO 4217 code money is reported in (default: the ad accounts' currency)
      --environment <production|sandbox|test>
                           Purchases revenue is read from: production, sandbox (App Store and Google
                           Play sandbox) or test (debug builds' simulated purchases and test modes
                           such as Stripe's) (default: production)
      --format <format>    Only creatives of this format: image, video or carousel; repeat for each
                           (can be repeated)
      --from <day>         First day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (instead of --last)
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API report as JSON, for scripts
      --last <span>        The complete days before today to report on: a span such as 7d, 4w, 3m or
                           1y (default: 30d)
      --limit <limit>      Creatives to show (default: 25, at most 100)
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
      --search <text>      Only creatives whose name contains this text
      --timezone <zone>    IANA time zone days are cut in (default: the ad accounts' time zone)
      --to <day>           Last day to report on, YYYY-MM-DD (default: today; with --from)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash ads report creatives
  voidhash ads report creatives --format video --last 90d
  voidhash ads report creatives --search "summer" --json
